note: Routes for scripts/oracle-diff.sh --mock: the Wave 1 command surface and the
Wave 2 mutation cases, one response per method+path, served to both binaries
Matching ignores the query, so the frozen CLI's state/top/skip and this
build's stateFilter/$top/$skip (D19) reach the same route and the difference
is read from the request log instead. `{base}` expands to the mock's own
origin, for the absolute artifact downloadUrl the CLI is asked to fetch (D25).
A route may carry `request_body`: the body a request must send (a string
compares as sent, an object or array structurally). The mock records
`body_matched` on the request line and the harness fails the case when it is
false, whether or not both binaries sent the same wrong bytes.
